purpose: Maximize hidden-continuation annualized daily net Sharpe, obeying the supplied causal and runtime contract and market-beta condition.
index_convention: All slice bounds are zero-based array indices with an exclusive upper bound; CSV day label = array index + 1.

replay.cost_timing: Same day's closing rebalance cost subtracted from that day's gross return; drift denominator uses gross return.

data_access.validation: At most three finalist specifications frozen before opening either block; same replay for both blocks; online updates under fixed policy allowed.
data_access.locked_audit: One frozen candidate after candidate engineering gates. Debug/runtime/causality checks before freeze use discovery/synthetic data.
data_access.contamination_rule: Any result-driven redesign after exposure is recorded; the reused interval is not described as untouched.

first_wave_budget.accounting: Every complete selectable pipeline counts; candidate-changing ablations count inside twelve. All diagnostics, feature scans, horizons, seeds, hand changes and stresses that influence choices are logged as exposures.
first_wave_budget.changes: Increase only with a written rationale and updated budget before more results; disclose whether previous results motivated expansion.
first_wave_budget.locked_audit_reproducibility_reruns: Exact reruns of the same frozen code/configuration for reproducibility and clean-folder execution are allowed and logged; no model/configuration change or retuning. A changed candidate is a new exposure and changes the clean-holdout claim.

hypotheses.nonlinear_challenger: Earned by discovery evidence; no prescribed winner or model architecture.

selection.primary: Pooled daily net Sharpe over [2016,3023); never mean of block Sharpes.
selection.eligible: Candidate passes causal, output/finite arithmetic, tested-path safety and measured runtime gates; pooled realized validation abs(beta) < 0.2 under our conservative interpretation.
selection.beta_note: The brief literally says beta under0.2. Absolute-beta screening and0.1 design goal are our choices, not extra employer requirements; future compliance is not guaranteed.
selection.tie_breaker: Simplicity rank assigned before validation, then lower measured runtime.
selection.diagnostic_role: Block stability, costs, risk, uncertainty and tails are reported; no arbitrary minimum Sharpe or requirement that every short block be profitable. Findings that trigger redesign consume validation and must be disclosed.
selection.undefined_metrics: No invented Sharpe or beta when variance is zero.

verification.policy: E2E preferred. No unit tests written after covered implementation. If isolation necessary: failure modes/expectations, then tests, then implementation.
verification.future_alteration: If rows[c:] change, all forecast channels through rowc inclusive and targets for earning days<=c must match; compare net/cost ledgers strictly beforec.
verification.state: Compare protected decisions and consumed state, not arbitrary future cache elements; use fresh processes for independent candidate runs.
verification.suffix_validity: Admissible perturbations only; later suffix failure is not itself proof of prefix leakage. Unavailable comparisons remain unverified.
verification.evidence: Setup/inputs/code hashes/exact command/environment/expectations/actual per-check outcomes/logs/daily outputs/status for every run.
verification.scope_note: Two-stock golden fixture checks scorer/harness; arbitrary universe generality is not an assignment requirement.

deadline.confirmation: Earlier email proposed finish Wednesday; no explicit final hour found.

attribution: Record actual AI and human contributions; do not invent human discoveries.
external_actions: No outgoing email or submission authorized by this planning request.
